name: ldb/ldb
description: LDB - a modern, fast web-based database administration tool (phpMyAdmin replacement) for MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server.

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required for MySQL / MariaDB / Percona connections
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlsrv: Required for Microsoft SQL Server connections (alternatively pdo_dblib)
suggest.ext-iconv: Enables CSV import from non-UTF-8 encodings (Shift_JIS, GB18030, CP1251, …)

scripts.lint: find src public config tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
